## SpaceX Accelerates Orbital Data Center Launch to 2027 with Nvidia Partnership; Louisiana Starbase Announced; JPMorgan Sees 75% Upside

An accelerated orbital data center timeline with an Nvidia partnership positions SpaceX at the intersection of two high-conviction mega-themes; if executed, this creates a genuinely differentiated AI compute layer that terrestrial hyperscalers cannot replicate, providing a structural moat argument that supports JPMorgan's bullish case and is a meaningful positive thesis catalyst for SPCX holders.

- SpaceX has pulled forward its orbital data center launch to 2027, with Musk confirming the timeline acceleration.
- The orbital data center is being built in partnership with Nvidia, linking the space economy and AI infrastructure themes directly.
- SpaceX simultaneously unveiled a new Starbase launch facility in Louisiana.
- JPMorgan has a price target implying 75% upside for SPCX; shares rose 3% on the announcement.
- Three outlets cover the story consistently on the 2027 timeline and Louisiana site details.
